description: Representative IPs pinned to CPython ipaddress is_global semantics (the engine's SSRF rule, apps/engine/app/utils/ssrf.py). blocked = is_global is False, allowed = is_global is True. blockedBeyondPython lists multicast addresses Python reports as global but the web deliberately still blocks (stricter than the engine; never looser). Consumed by the web sync test in apps/web/lib/generation/__tests__/public-ip-ssrf-sync.test.ts; the blocked/allowed lists include every literal representative asserted in apps/engine/test/utils/test_ssrf.py.
